snippet.title: Fractal Foundry - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
👉 Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4287960/Fractal_Foundry/

Fractal Foundry is a factory-building game where you automate the creation of fractal megastructures. Design nested factories that scale into recursive systems. No pressure, no costs, just pure creativity and automation.

Follow development:
Discord: https://discord.com/invite/P3CJ6ATuZG
Newsletter: https://subscribepage.io/6ICmpE
X / Twitter: https://x.com/MaxTinyRoot
TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@tinyrootstudio

Press Kit: 
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1VUPpMYmXnbg5vPI3Qhp3P9zEiUGpYpu9

Music by: @Effediem
